result.topic_en: Calculations on the deformation of a small volume element: displacements ξ, η, ζ, the change of the line element, the strain quadratic form in direction cosines α, β, γ, a characteristic (eigenvalue) determinant in μ, and the expansion of a symmetric 3×3 determinant.

methods.what: Squared length of deformed line element under displacement (ξ,η,ζ)
Linearized stretch of a direction (α,β,γ) as quadratic form set equal to (1+λ)^2
Characteristic determinant of the symmetric strain tensor for principal stretches μ
Leading terms of the cubic characteristic polynomial involving the divergence (trace)
